Messages.Author: sutekh_23
Messages.Body:
Hello all, Just a question regarding turn sequence, more specifically,
the ability to structure each phase. Is it allowable to structure your
discard phase in order to benefit from both vampires card text? ie: you
trigger Cyscek's ability and then Marcel's? I assume you can as you can
structure your other phases, but as these are both "triggered" events
(the playing of a event card) do they attempt to resolve at the same
time?

Cyscek
Clan: Tzimisce (group 4)
Capacity: 10
Disciplines: ANI AUS OBF VIC dem
Sabbat: When any Methuselah plays a Gehenna card while Cyscek is ready,
that Methuselah burns 1 pool, and you get the Edge. +1 stealth.

Rarity: Gehenna:U

and:

Marcel de Breau
Clan: Brujah antitribu (group 3)
Capacity: 9
Disciplines: CEL POT PRE ani pro
Sabbat Archbishop of Paris: If you have the Edge, you gain a pool when
any Methuselah plays a Gehenna card. +1 bleed.

Rarity: Gehenna:U

Cheers
Sutek_23

you cannot use Marcel's ability.
